title: Disable recent Applications in Kickoff History or reorder items
line: Kickoff has a new "Show applications in History and Frequently Used" checkbox; turning it off shows only recent files there.
explanation: Kickoff's History and Frequently Used pages use a RecentUsageModel that always mixes applications and files, grouped with applications first. With up to 30 items, the recent files sit below a long list of apps, and there was no way to change that. The change adds a showRecentApps setting (on by default, so nothing changes for existing users) with a checkbox in Kickoff's General settings; when it is off, both pages use the model's existing OnlyDocs mode, the same one Kicker uses for its Recent Files category.

commits.message:
applets/kickoff: add option to hide applications from History

History and Frequently Used always mixed recently used applications with
files, with applications first, so people who only want their recent
files had to scroll past apps. A new checkbox lets them show files only.

BUG: 389973

patches.diff:
From faebc9d08bf26637cd8d72ee5d534955d6de649e Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 20:17:45 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] applets/kickoff: add option to hide applications from History

History and Frequently Used always mixed recently used applications with
files, with applications first, so people who only want their recent
files had to scroll past apps. A new checkbox lets them show files only.

BUG: 389973
---
 applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml | 6 ++++++
 applets/kickoff/main.qml          | 2 ++
 applets/kickoff/main.xml          | 4 ++++
 3 files changed, 12 insertions(+)

diff --git a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
index 025cba4c49..8a606a5e63 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/ConfigGeneral.qml
@@ -39,6 +39,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
     property alias cfg_compactMode: compactModeCheckbox.checked
     property alias cfg_highlightNewlyInstalledApps: highlightNewlyInstalledAppsCheckbox.checked
     property alias cfg_switchCategoryOnHover: switchCategoryOnHoverCheckbox.checked
+    property alias cfg_showRecentApps: showRecentAppsCheckbox.checked
 
     Kirigami.FormLayout {
         QQC2.Button {
@@ -192,6 +193,11 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             text: i18nc("@option:check", "Switch sidebar categories when hovering over them")
         }
 
+        QQC2.CheckBox {
+            id: showRecentAppsCheckbox
+            text: i18nc("@option:check", "Show applications in History and Frequently Used")
+        }
+
         QQC2.Button {
             enabled: KConfig.KAuthorized.authorizeControlModule("kcm_plasmasearch")
             icon.name: "settings-configure"
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/main.qml b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
index 6b6c95dabe..da32126292 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/main.qml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/main.qml
@@ -106,12 +106,14 @@ PlasmoidItem {
     Kicker.RecentUsageModel {
         id: recentUsageModel
         favoritesModel: kickoff.rootModel.favoritesModel
+        shownItems: Plasmoid.configuration.showRecentApps ? Kicker.RecentUsageModel.AppsAndDocs : Kicker.RecentUsageModel.OnlyDocs
     }
 
     readonly property alias frequentUsageModel: frequentUsageModel
     Kicker.RecentUsageModel {
         id: frequentUsageModel
         favoritesModel: kickoff.rootModel.favoritesModel
+        shownItems: Plasmoid.configuration.showRecentApps ? Kicker.RecentUsageModel.AppsAndDocs : Kicker.RecentUsageModel.OnlyDocs
         ordering: 1 // Popular / Frequently Used
     }
     //END
diff --git a/applets/kickoff/main.xml b/applets/kickoff/main.xml
index 8f6a44e2a4..6dcb394d3b 100644
--- a/applets/kickoff/main.xml
+++ b/applets/kickoff/main.xml
@@ -73,5 +73,9 @@
             <label>Whether to highlight newly-installed applications</label>
             <default>true</default>
         </entry>
+        <entry name="showRecentApps" type="Bool">
+            <label>Whether to show applications in the History and Frequently Used pages, or only files</label>
+            <default>true</default>
+        </entry>
     </group>
 </kcfg>
-- 
2.53.0

media.caption: History on master: recent applications fill the list, the recent files are pushed below the fold.
With the new option turned off, History shows only the recent files.
Kickoff settings on master: no option for History.
The new "Show applications in History and Frequently Used" checkbox in Kickoff's General settings.
